text_block_list.text:
On my day off,
I attended a performance by a famous
orchestra.
I wanted to immerse myself in music to better
understand Sounds of Earth.
choice_data_list: (It's about to start...!)

text_block_list.text:
The vibrations created by the instruments
reverberate all the way to my seat.
A sheer power that you feel not just with
your ears, but with your entire body—
choice_data_list: (I'm simply overwhelmed...!)

text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap, clap, clap, clap!!!)
choice_data_list: (What an incredible performance...)

text_block_list.text: Bravissimo!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Even thunderous applause falls short
of expressing a fraction of the commozione
welling up in my heart!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And yet,
I shall keep clapping my hands together!
Benisssssimo!!!!
choice_data_list: Hey, Earth! You're here too!
Hey, Earth! You're here too!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Amore!
I had no idea you were a connoisseur of
concertos as well!
choice_data_list: As your Trainer, I wanted to learn...
As your Trainer, I wanted to learn...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. What delightful words to hear!
So, how did you like today's musica?
choice_data_list: Of course! I was deeply moved.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Naturally,
naturally! L'orchestra always performs
such soul-stirring melodia.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I must convey this commozione at once—
Don't you agree? Come, let us go together!
choice_data_list: Wait... go where?!

text_block_list.text:
Pulled along by the hand by Sounds of Earth,
I hurried out of the auditorium.
After breezing past backstage security on
recognition alone, we arrived at—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ciao, Mother! Everyone!
Today's performance stirred my very soul
once again! Grazie!!

text_block_list.name: Earth's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my angeli! How wonderful to see you!
Thank you for receiving our amore!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Indeed!
My Trainer was deeply moved as well!
They thoroughly savored the sublime violin
playing!
choice_data_list: Wait, your mother... Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Mamma mia!
I assumed you came knowing that already!

I thought the orchestra's name sounded
familiar,
and it turned out Sounds of Earth's mother
is their concertmaster.
choice_data_list: I'm so sorry, I was completely abs...

text_block_list.name: Earth's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu,
that is the highest compliment of all.
Thank you!
I look forward to hearing the sessions you
two create as well!

text_block_list.name: Orchestra Member A
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, is our little Earth doing well?
Please take good care of her,
she's like a daughter to all of us.
choice_data_list: A daughter?

text_block_list.name: Orchestra Member B
text_block_list.text:
Earth-chan's been tagging along with her
mother and
spending time around our orchestra ever
since she was tiny.

text_block_list.name: Orchestra Member B
text_block_list.text:
She used to toddle along right behind us,
and clapped after every single
performance—

text_block_list.name: Orchestra Member B
text_block_list.text:
So she really feels like 'the orchestra's
little girl.'

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Esattamente!
L'orchestra is my second family!

text_block_list.name: Orchestra Member A
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, aren't you sweet to say that.
I know you're busy with racing,
but come listen to us anytime!

text_block_list.name: Earth's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We'll welcome you with open arms full
of amore!
Come receive it whenever you like,
my sweet angeli!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Without question!
Everyone's musica is an irreplaceable energia
to me.
I will return whenever I need that
courage-boosting coraggio!

Afterward,
Sounds of Earth and I stopped by a café,
where I listened to her reminisce about her
past.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—They taught me so many things when I was
a child.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Giocoso, vivace, grazioso...
Words that gave form to the melodia that
"whispered" to me.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And how to converse with instruments, too—
They were all magnificent artisti.
It was an invaluable experience.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Making musica with them made my heart
dance,
and as a child,
I was utterly captivated by the act of
commanding notes at will.
choice_data_list: Is that also where you picked up t...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì!
The violin was the very first instrument I
ever touched!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I remember that moment vividly!
Out of all the instruments,
I reached for it without a moment's
hesitation!

text_block_list.name: Orchestra Member A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Earth-chan.
Which instrument would you like to play?

text_block_list.name: Young Earth
text_block_list.text: Hmm... This one! The violin!!

text_block_list.name: Young Earth
text_block_list.text:
I want the same one as Mama!
Mama's sound is so gentle, I love it!

text_block_list.name: Orchestra Member A
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is that so! Is that so!
Then how about we practice in secret and
surprise your mother?

text_block_list.name: Young Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Hey, can I try playing it? Just like Mama!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Mother often played the violin for me in
place of lullabies.
So when it came to choosing an instrument,
it was the only choice for me.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
From then on,
I threw myself into pratica every single
day.
I took my violin everywhere I went.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Every time I discovered a new word or
emotion,
I expressed it through my violin.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: At times, it was my passion for racing—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And at other times,
it was the deep emotion experienced during
a session—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
With a single stroke of the bow,
I could say so much.
Far more eloquently than words ever could.
choice_data_list: So you grew up alongside your violin.
So you grew up alongside your violin.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì. In the past, and for all time to come.
The violin is my finest partner.
choice_data_list: (Her finest partner... I hope I ca...
(A true partner... If only I could...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's the matter?
You have such a solemn look on your face.
choice_data_list: No, it's just... thanks for sharin...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: The pleasure is mine. I truly enjoyed our conversation today. Grazie, amore!

I learned that the bond between Sounds of
Earth, music,
and the violin runs far deeper than I could
have imagined.

Music is the very core of her being.
Perhaps immersing myself
in it more is one way I can become a true
partner to her.

She said the violin is an instrument that
can speak far more
eloquently than words ever could.
In that case—
choice_data_list: I want to learn how to play too!
I want to learn how to play too!

text_block_list.text:
I want to converse with Sounds of Earth even
more deeply than before.
With that thought in mind,
I decided to take up the violin.
